def glom(target, spec, **kwargs):
    scope = kwargs.pop('scope', _DEFAULT_SCOPE)
    if kwargs:
        raise TypeError('unexpected keyword args: %r' % sorted(kwargs.keys()))
    if scope is _DEFAULT_SCOPE:
        scope = ChainMap(dict(scope))
    return scope[glom](target, spec, scope)

def from_text(cls, text):
    return cls(Path.from_text(text))

def __init__(self, spec=None):
    self.spec = spec

def glomit(self, target, scope):
    return scope[glom](target, self.spec, scope)

def __repr__(self):
    cn = self.__class__.__name__
    return f'{cn}({bbrepr(self.spec)})'

def __init__(self, spec=None):
    self.spec = spec

def fill(self, target):
    return glom(target, self)

def __repr__(self):
    cn = self.__class__.__name__
    rpr = '' if self.spec is None else bbrepr(self.spec)
    return f'{cn}({rpr})'
